title: Scaffold a @fmmenchi/ui component with the full archetype
description: Creates src/components/<name>/ (component, types, variants, module.css, stories, mdx, tests, barrel) following the Button archetype, and wires the public surface: root barrel, package.json subpath exports, and the vite entry.

name.x-prompt: Which component do you want to scaffold? (kebab-case)

element.description: Native element the component builds on (native-first).

messages.description: Also scaffold a colocated .messages.ts catalog (only for components with DS-owned copy).
